spec_match.rationale: The chat panel is explicitly titled 'AI Assistant (simulated stream)' and the page banner states streamAppendHTML is unsupported here with an innerHTML fallback — honest simulation framing throughout.

interactive.rationale: Speed presets and three prompt buttons stream a canned response into the chat progressively; the driven Explain prompt rendered its streamed answer.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised AI-response streaming pattern demonstration.

edge_cases.rationale: Native-vs-fallback is labelled, but there is no cancellation/abort mid-stream case, which is the classic AI-stream edge.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 4 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: clicked Explain streamAppendHTML; the simulated response streamed into the chat with status transitions; zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables (34 var() hits), no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons are native but the streaming chat log is not a live region, so streamed content arrives silently for screen readers.

openQuestions.title: Add a mid-stream cancel control
openQuestions.detail: Aborting a WritableStream pipe mid-response is the differentiating edge for AI streaming; a Stop button exercising writer.abort() (and its fallback equivalent) would complete the pattern.

openQuestions.title: Make the chat transcript a live region
openQuestions.detail: role=log on the message list would let assistive tech follow the streamed answer.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: triggered the Explain prompt; a clearly-labelled simulated stream rendered progressively into the chat under the honest unsupported-fallback banner; zero console errors.
